name: Hitorijime! ~Mama mo Shimai mo Otonari-san mo~
original_name: ひとりじめ！～ママも姉妹もお隣さんも～
source:
The story of the game revolves around a nameable protagonist (whose default name is Shuugo) and a set of five heroines: his two sisters, the Genius Natsuki and the Modern Tsun Fuyu, along with his Osananajimi, the Deredere Akira, his mother Harue and a weird stalker-girl called Onko.

Being in love with the protagonist ever since childhood, Akira decides to confess to him at the first day of their high school life. They start going out, which is noticed by the Genius Natsuki. With her perception, Natsuki quickly recognizes the feelings of everyone, and in order to make all of them happy, she sets out her own plans and put them in motion.

How will this plan work? Who will be his girlfriend?

That's up to you to decide...
translation:
游戏故事围绕一位可自定义姓名的主人公（默认名为修吾）与5位女主角展开：他的两个姐妹——天才型的夏希和现代傲娇型的冬；青梅竹马、娇甜黏人的晶；母亲春江；以及名叫温子的古怪跟踪狂女孩。

晶从小便爱着主人公，决定在两人高中生活的第一天向他告白。他们开始交往，而这一切被天才夏希注意到。凭借敏锐的洞察力，夏希很快看穿了所有人的感情；为了让大家都获得幸福，她制定并开始实施自己的计划。

这个计划会产生怎样的结果？谁会成为他的女朋友？

一切都由你决定…
